task_completion.description: Load PDB 1BKV into the PyMOL workspace.

task_completion.description: Identify and color the three polypeptide chains (A, B, C) distinctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows three distinct colors (e.g., red, green, blue) corresponding to the three strands of the helix.

task_completion.description: Represent Glycine residues as spheres to highlight core packing.

task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line (dashed line) with a numerical label (likely between 4.0 and 6.0 Å) is visible connecting two atoms across chains.

task_completion.description: Generate the final cross-sectional visualization and the quantitative report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command or file browser view shows the creation of 'collagen_core.png' and 'collagen_report.txt' in the specified directory.
